name: Chiaki Ryousuke
source: Chiaki's mirror self. Unlike the real Chiaki he's a kind-hearted model student. He's also overly polite and very fond of Megumu, who he calls Megu-Megu-san. He doesn't believe in paranormal phenomena even after being surrounded by ghosts, which he deems unscientific.
